name: Israel Shipyards Industries Ltd
summary: Israel Shipyards Industries Ltd designs, constructs, markets, and sells military and civilian vessels in Israel and internationally. It operates cargo port that provides loading, discharging, sorting, storage, and transportation services; and imports, manufactures, markets, and sells cement and construction products, as well as offers vessel building and repair services. The company is also involved in the provision of logistics and support services for the offshore gas and petrol drilling operations. Israel Shipyards Industries Ltd was founded in 1959 and is based in Haifa, Israel.
